summary: Recognize fractal-prefixed run reports in indexed idle-wake reads.

replay.detail: No claim replay or completed idle-projection backfill. An unfinished initial backfill uses the widened fold and its existing cursor.

schema.detail: Store startup replaces the idle-message sent/delete/update v1 triggers with v2 folds. Tables, indexes, schema version, receipt trigger and canonical source_prefix key are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: The first message tag accepts st3-run-report:* or fractal-run-report:* and maps both to internal st3-run-report:. Existing indexed wait readers are unchanged. Writers still emit st3- tags; signed and stored messages are never rewritten.

downtime.detail: No service interruption beyond the normal upgrade restart is required.

manual.detail: Trigger replacement occurs automatically when a store opens.

recovery.detail: Legacy tags retain identical behavior. Keep writers on st3- until all readers are expanded; no data conversion is required.
